caveats: The GBIF waterBody field is blank. Preserve the combined source locality verbatim; do not assign the specimen to a specific river reach or draw a reservoir/riverside point.
The source date is 1929-05-18. This is historical evidence, not current presence or a complete Angat fish checklist.
GBIF reports individualCount 2 and infers occurrenceStatus PRESENT from the count; this remains one database occurrence record, not an abundance estimate.
The coordinate has 301 m uncertainty and a GBIF assumed-WGS84 flag; it is withheld from the app and map.
No catchability, legality, food safety, diet, bait, abundance, or fishing-access claim is made.
nonClaims: The record does not establish current presence, population size, abundance, a complete Angat or Bulacan fish list, or a precise point/reach within the combined locality.
